k17_resolution.question: is data/app/ledger/ledger.jsonl verifiable, and what is its entry_hash recipe?
k17_resolution.finding: the hash is over the PAIR {prev, body} produced by chain_hash() in scripts/pick_ledger.py, not over the body alone — which is why hashing the body under four canonicalisations never reproduced it. The recipe is documented in the writer and CI already runs `python3 scripts/pick_ledger.py verify`, which passes.
k17_resolution.conclusion: K-17 resolved as a documentation gap, not a linkage break. No entry was re-hashed and no file in another session's tree was modified.
